evidence.dedup: Searched public/data.json for Anh Tran, name-order variants, and the exact profile URL; ran npm run find-roster-matches for both Anh Tran and Tran Anh with the profile URL; checked maintenance/retired-ids.json and maintenance/sector-expansion/already-proposed.txt.
